نتسامع (form VI)
# نَتَسَامَعُ (natasāmaʕu) /na.ta.saː.ma.ʕu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of تَسَامَعَ (tasāmaʕa)
# نَتَسَامَعَ (natasāmaʕa) /na.ta.saː.ma.ʕa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of تَسَامَعَ (tasāmaʕa)
# نَتَسَامَعْ (natasāmaʕ) /na.ta.saː.maʕ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of تَسَامَعَ (tasāmaʕa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
